title: RFI-RAISED FLOORING-MARKET RESEARCH
agency: HOMELAND SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF > FEDERAL EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT AGENCY > REGION 10: FEDERAL EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT
description:
REQUIREMENT: 

 The Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA), Region 10, Bothell, Washington, is issuing an RFI to conduct market research, obtain pricing information, and identify qualified  participants capable of supporting the requirement for design services related to a proposed 3-inch raised flooring system in the FEMA Region 10 Regional Response Coordination Center (RRCC) at the Federal Regional Center and in accordance with the attached Performance Statement (PWS). The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this requirement is 236220 - Commercial and Institutional Building Construction..  

 This RFI is issued solely for market research and informational purposes and does not constitute an invitation for quotation, request for proposal or request for quotation, nor will responses be considered offers or result in a binding contract. It does not guarantee the future issuance of an opportunity notice, nor does it commit the government to execute an agreement or pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in responding to this notice. The U.S. Government will not provide reimbursement for any information that may be submitted in response to this RFI. Respondents are solely responsible for all expenses associated with responding to this RFI. Respondents will not be notified of any results derived from a review of the information provided; however, information gathered may be utilized for technical and acquisition purposes. 

  

 PLACE OF PERFORMANCE: 

 FEMA Region 10, Federal Regional Center (FRC) Region 10, 130 228th St SW, Bothell, WA 98021 

  

 Minimum Requirements: 

 Interested offerors are required to have an active registration in the System for Award Management (SAM).  Information regarding SAM registration is available at https://www.sam.gov/portal/public/SAM 

  

 SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS: 
FEMA Region 10 seeks information from firms with capabilities, experience, and resources necessary to meet or exceed the stated requirements to perform design services related to a proposed 3-inch raised flooring system. 

 Capability Statement Submission Requirements 

 Interested businesses are requested to submit a Capability Statement demonstrating their ability to fulfill the Government’s needs. Submissions must include the following information: 

 Company Information 

 
	 Company Name, Address, and Website. 
	 Point of Contact (Name, Title, Phone, and Email). 
	 Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) and CAGE Code. 
	 Business Size and Socio-Economic Status under NAICS 337215 (e.g., Large Business, Small Business, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business [SDVOSB], Women-Owned Small Business [WOSB], 8(a), HUBZone). 
	 Specify if your firm holds any Federal contract vehicles (e.g., GSA MAS, 8(a) STARS III, or regional IDIQs) that cover these types of commercial flooring installations. 
 

 Capabilities and Experience 

 
	 List any relevant qualifications or credentials 
 

 
	 Description of experience providing design services related to a proposed 3-inch raised flooring system of similar size and scope 
	 List of relevant contracts (government or commercial), including contract value and period of performance 
	 Key personnel qualifications 
 

 Technical Approach 

 
	 Overview of proposed approach to raised flooring (preventive, corrective, emergency maintenance) 
	 Use of technology (e.g., CMMS, energy management, automation). 
	 Quality assurance and performance metrics 
 

 
	 Innovative Technologies: Describe any innovative materials, methods, or technologies your firm could propose for a project of this scale that could lead to cost savings, schedule acceleration, or enhanced facility performance and resilience. 
	 Barriers to Innovation :  What commercial or Government-imposed barriers currently make it difficult to propose or implement innovative construction technologies? How could the flexibility of an OTA help overcome these barriers? 
 

 Pricing and Contract Structure 

 
	 Typical pricing models (firm-fixed price, time & materials, cost-plus), Estimated total cost for the design and CAD drawing services 
	 Recommendations for contract length, incentives, and performance-based measures 
	 Estimated labor categories, hourly rates, and total labor hours required for the assessment, design, and CAD drawing effort 
 

 Additional Information 

 •              Suggestions for improving the scope of work or performance requirements 

 •              Potential risks or challenges and recommended mitigation strategies 

 •              Any other relevant information or recommendations 

 Response Submission Instructions 

 •              Responses should be sent via email to nila.patel@fema.dhs.gov 

 •              Proprietary information should be clearly marked. 

 Responses received after the deadline or without the required information will not be considered. Since this is a request for information/market research announcement only, evaluation letters will not be issued to any respondent. 

 This RFI will be posted for 15 days, or until sufficient responses have been received. 

 Questions: 

 Direct any questions regarding this RFI to nila.patel@fema.dhs.gov. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted. 

  

 DISCLAIMER: 

 This RFI is for market research only and does not commit the Government to any contractual action. All responses are voluntary, and the Government is not obligated to any costs associated to a submitted response to this announcement.
